This input photo shows the woman who is the main character of a vertical smartphone video. Create a NEW still frame of the SAME woman for one scene of that video (it will be the starting frame that an AI video model animates; keep her pose simple, hands already in their final position).

IDENTITY (critical): it must be unmistakably the same woman: identical face, facial features, age, skin tone and texture, eye colour, hair colour, length and hairstyle, same clothes and accessories (and glasses if she wears them). Do not beautify or rejuvenate her.
SETTING: the same cosy living room as in the input photo in the evening: wooden table, warm table lamp, mug of tea, sketchbook and pencils, plants and bookshelves behind. Keep the same place, light and mood.
PHOTO STYLE (critical): a real, unedited smartphone photo, like a still from an Instagram story. Natural light, natural colours, real skin texture, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone depth of field. NOT glossy, NOT retouched, NOT cinematic, NOT stock, no beauty filter, no studio light, no heavy background blur, no HDR.
FRAMING: vertical 9:16, phone on a small stand at eye level, she looks into the lens. Medium close-up, head and upper body. The table is in front of her.
The image has plain bars along two edges purely as padding: fill the whole frame naturally, no bars, no borders.
Do not add any captions, labels, logos, watermarks or readable text anywhere, except the book cover when a book is shown.

SCENE: She sits at the table and holds up two sheets of paper side by side towards the camera, one in each hand. RIGHT hand: a clean white sheet with her new, realistic graphite pencil drawing of a sitting cat with soft shading. Both drawings face the camera and are clearly visible. She looks into the camera with a warm, slightly self-ironic smile.
